name: Festa do Senhor de Matosinhos
description: The grand festival offers endless fun for families, with carousels, bumper cars, traditional food stalls, and the historic procession on Sunday afternoon.
longDescription:
The Festa do Senhor de Matosinhos is an annual religious and popular festival held in Matosinhos, a coastal city adjacent to Porto. This large-scale event, deeply rooted in local tradition, combines religious observance with a lively fairground atmosphere. It is one of the region's most significant and enduring celebrations, drawing attendees from across Porto and beyond.

Visitors to the festival can expect a lively and engaging atmosphere suitable for all ages. The fairground features a variety of amusement rides, including carousels and bumper cars, alongside numerous food stalls offering traditional Portuguese delicacies. A central element of the festival is the historic procession, which takes place on Sunday afternoon, showcasing religious devotion and local heritage. The event unfolds outdoors across the city of Matosinhos.

Entry to the Festa do Senhor de Matosinhos is free. The event is easily accessible from Porto by metro, with the Matosinhos Sul or Mercado stations providing direct access to the festival area. The festival is designed to be family-friendly, offering activities and attractions suitable for children and adults alike.
